FOREWORD

This wiring diagram manual has been prepared to provide information on the electrical system of the 1995 SUPRA.

Applicable models:    JZA 80 Series

For service specifications and repair procedures of the above models other than those listed in this manual, refer to the following manuals:

Manual Name | Pub. No.

• 1995  SUPRA Repair Manual
                          Volume 1    RM408U1
                          Volume 2    RM408U2
• 1995  TOYOTA New Car Features    NCF109U

All information in this manual is based on the latest product information at the time of publication.  However, specifications and procedures are subject to change without notice.

TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION

NOTICE
When handling supplemental restraint system components (removal, installation or inspection, etc.), always follow the direction given in the repair manuals listed above to prevent accidents and supplemental restraint system malfunction.
